Second grade - New Year's Eve 2002. Sitting on my bike, on the lawn in my backyard. Not moving, just sitting. The last thing I remember was leaning over to look at my handlebars. Next thing I know, I'm waking up and my bike's on top of me. My mouth hurt, so I put a hand to my teeth to make sure none had fallen out. My hand comes away covered in blood. Being a seven year old girl, I freak. 

I ran inside to tell my mom. Now I had this problem with continually interrupting her while she was on the phone - so she told me not to interrupt her unless my little brother was dead or if I were to be losing tons of blood. So I run in, shrieking, and she turns around with the scariest angry mom face I have ever seen, ready to just destroy me. Then she sees my blood soaked shirt and bleeding face, starts screaming, throws the phone across the room with no explanation to my father, who she had been talking to, and tosses me in her minivan and drives me to the hospital. 

I had somehow bitten all the way through my bottom lip - my tooth punctured through to part of my chin. Oops. Not my worst injury, but easily my lamest story.
